content: Ghongoni nde uyekuliku waka Yesu Kristo, ghoakapekiwi na Chapanga nahuli abhalangihaje bhatumika bhaki ghala ghaghipitalyaje henu kateki. Kristo akuntumiki mtumika waki wa kunani kumahunde ampwaghila mtumika waki Yohana mambu ghanihagha.
Najombi Yohana akapwaghiki ghokapi ghaakaghaweni. Yohana akalandili Lilobhi laka Chapanga na uchakaka ghoukayekuliwi na Yesu Kristo.

Apengaliki mundu jola joasoma malobhi ghangani gha ulota, na apengaliki jola joaghajowana na kughakamula malobhi gha ulota ghaghalembakiki mu chitabu chenjenu, maghambu chikahi cha kupitalila mambu ghangani uheghalile.
Yohana aghalamukila makanisa saba

Nepani Yohana, naghalembela makanisa saba gha ku Asia: Nundobhela chihomu na lukwali, yeihuma kwaka Chapanga joabhile, joakabhile na joanahikaje, na yeihuma kwa roho saba yeibhi palongi ja chitehu chaki cha kikolongwa,

na kuhuma kwaka Yesu Kristo, mlandilu ndongwana, joabhi wa kutumbula kuhyohakeka kuhuma kwa bhakuwa, na ambaju nde mtawala wa bhakolongwa bha pundema. Kwaki jombi joatupala na kutugholola mahoku ghitu mu mwahi waki,
na kutuhenga kubha ukolongwa na bhapenganyambiku kwaka Chapanga, najombi nde Atati waki. Ulumbalilu na lujiniku ibhi najombi Yesu Kristo mileli na mileli! Amina.

Lingalyaje! Ahika na mahunde na kila mundu anaambonaje, hata bhala bhabhakunhotwili nkoha, na makabila gha bhandu bhokapi bha pundema anabhaombulizaje kwa ndandi jaki. Anana, nde mokwibhelilaje! Amina.
Bambo Chapanga Mweni Makili, joabhile, na joakabhile na joanahikaje, apwagha: “Nepani nde Alufa na Omega, yani, utumbulilu na ujomukelu.”
Mabhono ghaka Yohana kubhokana na Kristo

Nepani Yohana, nundongu winu kwa kulombana na Yesu, nombana papamu na mwehapa mu mang'ahiku na Ukolongwa na uhinakilu. Nepani nakapelakiki muchifungo mu chilu chechilowakeka Patimo, maghambu nakabhi nabhatangazi bhandu Lilobhi laka Chapanga, na kubhalandi bhandu uchakaka ghowayekuliwi na Yesu.
Mu Lichobha laka Bambo, nakatwelakiki na Roho waka Chapanaga, nakajowini sauti ngolongwa kunyuma jangu, ngati sauti ja lipenga,
jakapwaghaje: “Ulembaje mu chitabu ghala ghaughabhona, na ukapelakaje kwa makanisa saba gha ku Asia: Efeso, na Similina, na Peligamo, na Tiatila, na Sadi, na Filadefia, na Laodikia.”
Bhela, nakang'anambwiki nahuli numbonaje jola joakabhi alongela na nepani. Na panang'anambwike, nakaiweni inala saba ya taa ya zahabu,
na pachilanda ja inala ya taa yela nakumbweni mundu ulenganesu waka Mwana waka Mundu, akabya awati ingobhu jilachu mbaka kumagholu, na akongiki ulamba wa zahabu pachihimba chaki.
Mmutu waki na majunju ghaki ghakabhi mahuhu kupukupu ngati sufi, mahuhu ngati seluji, na mihu ghaki ghakabhi ngati lumuli lwa moto.
Magholu ghaki ghakang'anyiki ngati shaba jejihingakiki mu mvuni wa moto na kuhingakika nakanopi, na sauti jaki jakabhi ngati sauti ja machi ghaghahele punhelelo.
Mu chiwoku chaki cha kumalelelu akakamwi ndondwa saba na mundomu waki lakapitiki lipanga likali, lelitema koni na koni. Pamihu jaki pakabhi pang'anya ngati lyobha likali la muhe.
Panakumbweni, nakahawiki pamagholu ghaki ngati mundu joapotile. Nambu akamekili chiwoku chaki cha kumalelelu akapwaghaje: “Ngawijoghopa! Nepani nde wa kutumbula na wa kujomukela.
Nepani nde jombi joabhi mwome! Nakabhi mbotile, nambu sajenu mili mwome mileli na mileli. Mili nayu funguu ya nyiwa na ya kuwawa.
Bhela, ulembaje mambu ghaughaweni, mambu ghokapi ghaughabhona sajenu na mambu ghokapi ghaghipitalya palongi.

Jenjenu nde ndandi ja ndondwa saba yeukaiweni mu chiwoku changu cha kumalelelu, na inala saba ya zahabu yela: Ndondwa saba yela nde bhatumika saba bha makanisa saba ghala, na inala saba yela nde makanisa saba.
